scope: Generated-source control for the opt-in eleven-XRECORD AC1018 TABLESTYLE source-observation bundle. This tests the selected source binding, not complete table-graph closure, semantic interoperability or output support.
construction: The test locally authors an AC1018 drawing with a three-by-three typed TABLE, synthetic 2104-byte proxy cache, one owned block LINE, a valid empty TABLE extension dictionary, a separate populated dictionary, TABLESTYLE, its extension dictionary, the root and nine child XRECORDs, style XRECORD, and independently generated TABLECONTENT, DATATABLE and TABLEGEOMETRY source bodies. No drawing fixture is committed. The writer emits an empty TABLE extension only, as required by its production output gate. Scratch-only equal-length source-frame rewrites then redirect TABLE H3 to the separately authored populated dictionary and normalize selected generated wire bodies; every replacement checks its object frame CRC and recomputes object and enclosing uncompressed page checksums. These test bytes do not demonstrate writer support for the populated graph.
witness_limits: This intentionally assembled input does not establish its overall graph is valid for output. In particular, source TABLESTYLE is normalized from a seven-character authoring name to Standard while the NOD style-dictionary key remains its original spelling; this graph edge is outside the capability tested. The source references numeric CELLSTYLEMAP target without supplying its frame. Synthetic proxy bytes are opaque and are not qualified visual graphics.
controls: The full 11-XRECORD plus seven selected candidate source bundle seals and verifies through the actual reader and dedicated stronger query.
The valid baseline still fails strict DXF output and preserves a destination sentinel.

A valid-CRC local group-90 style XRECORD mutation leaves the prior 10-XRECORD dictionary selection/query valid but prevents the stronger bundle from sealing and revokes singular source queries; restoring the body succeeds on the same reader.

Harness refuses a pre-existing scratch test directory and sentinel destination. Two consecutive CTest runs passed; a pre-existing scratch-directory sentinel was preserved when the harness refused.
remaining: Independent semantic/platform qualification, CELLSTYLEMAP source in a generated full graph, graph dependency/handle remapping, strict whole-graph output/readback, and authentic additional producer evidence remain separate. The test does not broaden support claims.
